verdict.rationale: Alloy's homepage claims "fully auditable agentic automation" for KYC/KYB and AML checks. That is the product's own agentic capability in the screening domain, and "auditable" implies some record of its work. However, this single marketing line does not describe an in-product agent reviewing screening or watchlist matches, nor recording a per-decision rationale. Missing for 10: documentation of an agent that dispositions screening matches, evidence that the agent's rationale is recorded per match, a description of the review workflow or UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
